[b][u]Translation[/u][/b]

[b][i]Description [/i][/b]
Professor Snape's life and romance in Stardew Valley. 
[b][i]Installation Instructions [/i][/b]
Install SMAPI and place the mod in the "Mods" folder. 
[b][i]Main Features [/i][/b]
An experience for all Professor Snape fans: get closer to him, understand him, and share life with him. 
Requirements 
No HP/SS content, no Snape-bashing, no pro-Marauder rhetoric, no "Snaily" appreciation; no "shipping" posts forced into the discussion. For bug reports, please join the beta testing group: 1037387050. 

Credits Special thanks to my friend Iris for creating the portraits, sprites, and Snape's unique letters. 
Special thanks to beta tester Lumos for creating the sprites, Snape's wand, the matching couple's rings, Snape's brewed potions, and his spouse room. 
2-Heart Event: Wizard's Tower (requires unlocking the tower by completing Community Center quests). 
4-Heart Event: The Beach (visit on a rainy day after viewing the 2-heart event). 
6-Heart Event: Secret Woods (7:00 PM – 2:00 AM). 
8-Heart Event: The Mines (9:00 AM – 9:00 PM). 
10-Heart Event: Cindersap Forest (9:00 AM – 7:00 PM). 
Post-Marriage(MUST UPGRADE FARMHOUSE): 12-Heart Event: Return home after 7:00 PM; visit the Desert Mines on a sunny day between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. 14-Heart Event: Triggered after completing the 12-heart event and receiving an invitation from Snape; visit Ginger Island between 9:00 AM and 7:00 PM the following day.
